Abstract.AbstractText: I describe the surgical technique of laparoscopic transabdominal preperitoneal bilateral inguinal hernia repair with single large mesh according to Stoppa's principles. For repair of bilateral inguinal hernia, Stoppa reported a recurrence rate of 1,4 per cent using a preperitoneal approach (1,2). The endoscopic technique for bilateral inguinal hernia is attractive since it is known to cause less postoperative pain and ensure more rapid recovery than conventional hernia repair (3-4).
